doc: Transition feeding of children 6–59 months of age with severe acute malnutrition

entries.claim: 对于6-59个月严重急性营养不良的住院儿童，在康复期使用RUTF作为治疗食物时，一旦患儿稳定、有食欲且水肿减轻，应从F-75过渡到RUTF，持续2-3天，根据耐受情况调整。
entries.source_doc: Transition feeding of children 6–59 months of age with severe acute malnutrition

entries.claim: 过渡期推荐能量摄入为100-135 kcal/kg/天。
